summary: Button’s CEO told Levanta’s Creator Commerce Commune that creator audiences plus retail media budgets dwarf affiliate alone ($44B creator + $71B retail media vs $18B performance creator).
Amazon launched free Uber Eats delivery for Prime members ordering through Amazon — a retail perk, not an Associates change.
Pretty Links published a full Instagram affiliate marketing guide; Bitly pushed episode 4 of its Click Worthy podcast.
Lasso, URLgenius and Amazon Associates/Influencer feeds were quiet on product news; several Reddit competitor searches were rate-limited (429).

items.title: When creator audiences meet retail media budgets, the opportunity is far bigger than affiliate alone. That was the heart of our CEO Michael Jaconi’s conversation at Levanta’s Creator Commerce Commune.
items.why: A deep-linking rival is pitching itself at the join between creators and retail media, not just classic affiliate.

items.title: Every point of friction in the mobile journey is a conversion left on the table — webinar on Driving Higher Mobile Conversions Through Personalisation and Seamless App Journeys.
items.why: Button keeps selling the mobile deep-link story: fewer taps between a tip and the app checkout.

items.title: Amazon announces partnership with Uber Eats offering Prime members $0 delivery
items.why: Prime perks keep widening. Not an Associates change, but another reason shoppers start on Amazon.

items.why: A WordPress link-shortener rival is publishing how-to content aimed at Instagram affiliates.

items.why: Bitly is building a brand-content podcast rather than shipping link-product news.
